commercialConflict: Meal Monster publishes this resource and sells one of the listed apps.

definitions.buddyNoOwnPlan: Buddy needs no separate paid plan
definitions.friendCalorieWidget: Friend’s food-calorie numbers in a widget

notes: Yes and No describe the reviewed published scope, not a permission-enforcement test.
Unknown means not established in this review, not absent.
One subscription covering a pair is different from both people having free access.
A personal-calorie, workout, or status-only widget does not establish a widget showing a friend’s food-calorie numbers.
Body weight is distinct from weight-change achievements or numbers someone manually puts into a message.
The selection is purposive and not a complete market census.

apps.name: Meal Monster
apps.role: Food tracker with optional trusted-friend sharing
apps.scope: Per-friend calorie sharing; a free Supporter can follow a Tracker.
advisories: Food logging requires Pro. The free Supporter role does not include personal food tracking.
The reviewed policy documents a friend-calorie widget; shipping-version capacity has not been checked.

calorieTotals.detail: Consented daily calories and base goal.

mealDiary.detail: Friends do not receive meals or food names.

weightPrivate.detail: Weight is excluded from Friends sharing.

buddyNoOwnPlan.detail: Free Supporter role; Tracker logging is paid.

friendCalorieWidget.detail: Authorized names and calorie totals in a widget.

apps.name: Daypair
apps.role: Accountability companion; not a food logger
apps.scope: Reads permitted daily totals from Apple Health or accepts a check-in.
advisories: A food logger must write the relevant nutrition data to Apple Health for automatic use; manual check-ins are separate.
The store advertises status-only widgets while the homepage labels that section “In the next update”. Confirm availability on the installed version.
Free food/step pacts and paid group hosting are different access rules.

buddyNoOwnPlan.detail: Food/step pair and joining a group are free.
